title: A Slice of Bread Was Always One Number. Not Anymore | vitalii.no
description:
Every food on Artem's plate used to carry one fixed carb, protein and fat number per serving. A slice of bread was always the same 'serving' no matter how big it actually was, a sandwich couldn't be built from its real parts, and there was no way to say 'he only ate half the potatoes' without the dose math going wrong.

app/js/day.js's FOODS array now stores real per-100-gram values, a default weight, an adjustment step, and the real Matvaretabellen id for 23 foods, including newly split-out bread, cheese, margarine and jam, plus added potato, chicken, lompe and rice. The plate is now a list of [food, grams] pairs, and plateSum() multiplies each food's per-100g values by grams/100 instead of counting fixed servings. The doctor's warm-up-day meal plan was rewritten in real grams too.

Artem's parents can now adjust exactly how many grams of each food he ate, and the NovoRapid dose calculation always follows the real per-100g values pulled from Matvaretabellen instead of a fixed per-serving guess.
